sloka: मया एकन तु निर्युक्तः परिमुच्यस्व राघव ।माम् हि भूत बलिम् दत्त्वा पलास्व यथा सुखम् ॥३-६९-३९॥
transliteration: mayā ekana tu niryuktaḥ parimucyasva rāghava ।mām hi bhūta balim dattvā palāsva yathā sukham ॥3-69-39॥

translations.english: Giving me to this monstor as an offering, you may run away happily. I think you will soon obtain Vaidehi.
